display.purpose: Hero headlines only (e.g. the Landing page hero line).

headline.purpose: Section headings, modal titles, card titles, the nav wordmark.

body.purpose: Reading content — card copy, comments, descriptions.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, form labels, short interactive text.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modals — the largest, softest shadow in the system.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Toasts, map search box, small tooltips, the mobile drawer.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA buttons only — uses the accent's own color, not black.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus transition for opacity, border-color, and background across buttons and inputs.

motion.name: card-lift
motion.purpose: Card hover: translateY(-4px) plus border-color shift to Ember Orange.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button — sign up, submit, save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #c87a30, #8b4a18); color: #fef3e6; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px 24px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(200,122,48,0.3); transition: opacity 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(200,122,48,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c87a30; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel/ghost button, paired with a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #6a5848; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #2a2420; border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px 24px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #c87a30; color: #d8c8b8; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Problem/spot card, used in scrollable lists and grids.
components.html:
V4 — Sunset Slab

Overhang start, crimpy top-out.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141210; border: 1px solid #2a2420; border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #c87a30; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 700; color: #f0e0c8; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; color: #d8c8b8; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field — auth forms, comment box, problem forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1a1612; border: 1px solid #2a2420; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; color: #d8c8b8; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4a3c30; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #c87a30; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top-bar navigation link, with the inset-underline active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; color: #8a7060; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 4px; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #d8c8b8; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #f0e0c8; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #c87a30; }

narrative.overview:
Palabatu is a boulder at dusk: near-black stone (#0f0d0b-#1a1612) holding the last warmth of an ember-orange accent (#c87a30), with text the color of chalk on old sandstone (#f0e0c8). The system is single-theme dark, and depth comes from tonal layering (ink -> panel -> surface, each a shade lighter) rather than shadows. Two serif/sans faces carry the whole voice: Playfair Display for anything that should feel like a signature or a headline, DM Sans for everything you actually read and interact with.
The mood is warm and grassroots - this is a community-run app for climbers, not a SaaS dashboard - and every screen should be checked against that: no glossy everywhere-gradients, no generic blue-accent dashboard look, nothing that reads as a stock tech-startup template. That warmth doesn't mean unfinished - the grassroots feel and a credible, premium level of polish coexist; sloppy execution is not part of the aesthetic.
Components should feel tactile and warm: soft radii, an accent-tinted glow on primary actions, a gentle lift on hover for anything clickable. Nothing here is clinical or flat-by-decree - the one deliberate restraint is that the ember accent stays rare, so its glow still reads as warmth rather than noise.
keyCharacteristics: Single dark theme; depth via tonal layering (ink/panel/surface/border), not drop shadows on static content.
One accent color, used sparingly, always warm (ember-orange gradient), never a second competing hue for primary actions.
Playfair Display for display/headline moments only; DM Sans for everything else - never mixed within the same text block.
Shadows reserved for things that float above the page (modals, dropdowns, toasts, the mobile drawer) and for the accent-tinted glow under primary CTAs.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember Orange is the only warm accent used for action and attention. A second hue competing for the same role is a bug, not a design choice - new UI reaches for Moss Green or Ember Red only for their specific semantic roles (success/associate, danger), never as a second general-purpose accent.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Every piece of text is either Playfair Display (display/headline) or DM Sans (body/label) - never a third face, never Playfair Display below headline size, never DM Sans for a hero line.

rules.name: The One Breakpoint Rule
rules.body: Design for two states - phone and "wider than phone" - around the 640-768px band. Don't design a three- or four-tier responsive system.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is above the page" or "this is the primary action." Static page content never gets a shadow at rest; use the tonal ladder and border-color instead.

dos: Do use the @theme tokens in src/index.css (bg-panel, text-accent, font-serif, etc.) for new or rewritten components, rather than hand-rolled hex literals.
Do keep shadows reserved for floating UI and primary-button glow; use the tonal ladder plus border-color shifts for everything else.
Do implement input/link focus and hover states as CSS pseudo-classes, not manual JS onFocus/onBlur style mutation.
Do keep Ember Orange rare - one accent, used deliberately, not spread across multiple simultaneous elements on the same screen.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue for a general "primary" role - Moss Green and Ember Red are semantic-only.
Don't mix modal radii - converge new and touched modals on xl (20px) rather than the stray 24px (rounded-3xl) instance.
Don't add a neutral-gray shadow-md/shadow-lg Tailwind utility to static page content.
Don't use Playfair Display below headline size, or DM Sans for a hero-scale headline.
Don't add a third Tailwind breakpoint tier (md:/lg:/xl:) without a real reason.
